feature_name: UiApp hyperlink and rich input widgets
summary: Several UiApp widgets, including Hyperlink, InlineHyperlink, LayoutPanel, RichTextArea, and SuggestBox, were deprecated; deprecated on 2013-03-18.
extended_definition: Several UiApp widgets, including Hyperlink, InlineHyperlink, LayoutPanel, RichTextArea, and SuggestBox, were deprecated; deprecated on 2013-03-18.

evidence_snippets: FileIterator.getContinuationToken() FolderIterator.getContinuationToken() DriveApp.continueFileIterator(continuationToken) DriveApp.continueFolderIterator(continuationToken) Deprecated The UiApp widgets Hyperlink , InlineHyperlink , LayoutPanel , and RichTextArea have now been disabled, as announced on March 13, 2013 and documented in the Apps Script sunset schedule .
Deprecated Deprecated the GUI Builder and the UIApp widgets Hyperlink , InlineHyperlink , LayoutPanel , RichTextArea , and SuggestBox , which had limited usability.

Page Summary outlined flag Several Apps Script services have been updated, including the Spreadsheet, Forms, Calendar, Docs, Chat, and Google Workspace Add-ons services, adding new features and capabilities.
